electro-808-beat.intent: Long 808 boom, clap on 2 and 4, 16th hats with accents and a two-bar cowbell: breakbeat electro.

electro-808-kick.intent: A long sine boom with a gentle pitch drop on the electro-funk kick pattern.

electro-cowbell.intent: Two squares a fifth apart through a band-pass, on a two-bar pattern.

electro-funk-bass.intent: Square bass with a resonant filter blip on a syncopated line.
electro-funk-bass.lowered:
setcpm(124/4)
$: note("<[f1 ~ ~ f1 ~ ~ f2 ~ ~ f1 ~ ~ ab1 ~ c2 ~] [db2 ~ ~ db2 ~ ~ db1 ~ ~ eb2 ~ ~ eb1 ~ c2 ~]>").hpf(40).lpf(3500).s("square").attack(0.012).decay(0.25).sustain(0.3).release(0.08).lpf(600).lpq(5).lpenv(2.5).lpdecay(0.12).gain(0.38)

vocoder-lead.intent: Saw through a vowel formant that changes every beat (a, e, i, o): a robot voice without a vocoder.
vocoder-lead.lowered:
setcpm(124/4)
$: note("<[f4 ~ ab4 ~ c5 ~ ab4 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ eb4 ~ f4 ~] [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]>").hpf(150).lpf(8000).s("sawtooth").vowel("a").attack(0.01).sustain(0.7).release(0.1).lpf(3200).vib(5).vibmod(0.04).gain(0.3).vowel("<[a e i o] [o]>")

robot-stabs.intent: Square chords through a vowel formant on an offbeat stab rhythm.
robot-stabs.lowered:
setcpm(124/4)
$: note("<[f3,ab3,c4,f4] [db3,f3,ab3,db4] [eb3,g3,bb3,eb4] [c3,eb3,g3,c4]>").hpf(120).lpf(8000).s("square").vowel("e").attack(0.003).decay(0.15).sustain(0).lpf(2400).lpenv(2).lpdecay(0.1).gain(0.16).struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~")

electro-house-bass.intent: Resonant saw bass with a 3-octave filter envelope and drive on the offbeat 8ths.

sidechain-supersaw-stabs.intent: A four-on-the-floor kick ducks the supersaw stabs and the bass on orbit 3 (glyphcore/edm sidechain on the kick, ducked on the targets: superdough duckorbit), so the stabs land where the pump lets go.
sidechain-supersaw-stabs.code:
setcpm(128/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:atoms-electro")
// racks: pack:glyphcore/edm:racks-edm-core
$: s(atoms.el.ehKick).hook("houseKick | sidechain(3, 0.8, 0.18)")
$: note(atoms.el.chords).hook("sawStab | ducked(3)").struct(atoms.el.ehStabs)
$: note(atoms.el.ehBass).hook("filterBass | ducked(3)")
sidechain-supersaw-stabs.lowered:
setcpm(128/4)
$: s("x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~").hpf(30).lpf(7000).s("sine").freq(55).attack(0.003).penv(26).pdecay(0.04).decay(0.28).sustain(0).hpf(38).lpf(6000).gain(0.8).duckorbit(3).duckdepth(0.8).duckattack(0.18)
$: note("<[f3,ab3,c4,f4] [db3,f3,ab3,db4] [eb3,g3,bb3,eb4] [c3,eb3,g3,c4]>").hpf(100).lpf(9000).s("supersaw").hpf(180).unison(7).detune(0.35).spread(0.6).attack(0.003).decay(0.28).sustain(0).lpf(5000).lpenv(1).lpdecay(0.2).gain(0.13).orbit(3).struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~")
$: note("<[~ ~ f1 ~ ~ ~ f1 ~ ~ ~ f1 ~ ~ ~ f2 ~] [~ ~ db2 ~ ~ ~ db2 ~ ~ ~ eb2 ~ ~ ~ c2 ~]>").hpf(40).lpf(3500).s("sawtooth").attack(0.004).sustain(0.5).release(0.08).lpf(500).lpq(6).lpenv(2.5).lpdecay(0.15).gain(0.28).orbit(3)

clap-build.intent: Electro house clap build on the shared roll grammar: density doubles toward the drop (glyphcore/edm ec.roll8) while the velocity ramps up (ec.rollVel8).
